title: Mystic Studio Meltdown
description: A bearded man in a dark jacket sits on an office chair in a gothic stone chamber, intently focused on an ornate open laptop. Golden liquid spills from the laptop onto the wet floor while a spectral white figure, black birds, cherry blossoms, glowing crystals, and aurora lights float in the surreal dreamlike space around him.
prompt: A bearded man wearing a dark jacket sits on an office chair inside a gothic stone chamber with arched windows, focused on an ornate open laptop. Golden liquid spills from the laptop onto the wet floor. A translucent white spectral female figure with flowing hair floats above, surrounded by black birds, falling pink cherry blossoms, glowing blue and purple crystals, lotus flowers, and a vibrant green and purple aurora borealis in the night sky visible through the window.
